scope: Exact frozen maintenance-plan checkpoint export and explicit restoration when the current replica index and signed retention ledger survive. Combined journal or volume loss remains open.
sourceReuse: All production Go files are hash-identical between these trees; only the actual CLI test, documentation and native workflow were added.

environment.concurrentWork: An independently isolated physical100GiB source generator remained active. This run establishes functional safety, not throughput.

checks: Exact original canonical plan and independently retained digest
Original index and signed ledger required
Original permit, operation and plan digest must match
No candidate rescan, payload deletion, new execution window or index/ledger/receipt update
Atomic no-replacement publication preserves a foreign file created during quota admission
Conflicting file or symlink, changed hash or operation, missing index or ledger, cancelled context and exhausted quota refused
Real SIGKILL after durable plan publication, exact idempotent recovery and safe maintenance replay
Later orphan and newly referenced candidates protected by original frozen replay checks
Active worker lease and foreign domain refused
Selected actual CLI export, private input, no output overwrite, active-worker refusal, wrong digest, recovery and idempotent replay
Completed operations retain original outcomes; their absent plans are not recreated

actualCLI.existingEnvelope: outpost-cli-1 with the operation result in result
actualCLI.earlierTestCorrection: The first CLI test inspected fields outside the existing result envelope. Its failed log is retained; the product response format was unchanged.

compatibility: The existing outpost-gc-plan-1 file, replica state, deletion permit and wire catalog formats are unchanged. Normal maintenance still enforces its original window and current references.
unverified: Combined index/retention/plan loss or complete replica volume loss
Automatic off-node checkpoint retention and periodic permit lifecycle
